comment: Documentation versions, newest first. A version is a minor release (x.y); its patch releases (x.y.Z) are listed in `releases`, oldest first, and are documented inside it. `source` is the kividb git ref the newest release of the version is built from. `withdrawn` maps a release that was withdrawn to why, in Markdown; it stays listed, with that note.

withdrawn.1.1.1: Under a high rate of writes with a TTL, background expiry falls behind and memory grows without bound ([#87](https://github.com/kividbio/kividb/issues/87)). Use 1.1.2, a patch release of 1.1.0 that includes everything in 1.1.1 and the fix. The 1.1.1 images and packages are still published, so that a pinned deployment does not break.
